we have proposed a new method that achieves fast similarity search for large video sequence database.
we propose a novel video representation called ViTri and a one dimensional transformation to reduce the number of video similarity computations.

the proposed methods are effective for very large scale video sequence similarity search, and they are efficient in both computation time and memory consumption.
